context_map.exchanged_information: Account frozen notices and funds reserved/released outcomes for a payment's hold.
context_map.boundary_protection: Payments sees only the hold outcome and frozen status, never Account State internals or overdraft rules.

context_map.exchanged_information: Funds reserved/released facts used to derive Available Balance.
context_map.boundary_protection: Ledger keeps its own balance view; hold lifecycle and Account State stay in Accounts.

context_map.exchanged_information: Account creation fact for onboarding screening.
context_map.boundary_protection: Screening receives only the creation fact; Account Hold stays out of Compliance Hold.

cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Eventual; account stays PROVISIONAL until activation.
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Customer verification context is an open question.

cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Balance read must be current at the time of the closure decision; otherwise closure is refused.
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Balance ownership stays in General Ledger; sync-vs-event read is open.
